sources.title: Understanding biodiversity net gain
sources.role: Defra guidance explaining mandatory biodiversity net gain in England.
sources.facts: Published 21 February 2023; updated 14 July 2026; applies to England; explains BNG measurement, delivery routes and affected parties.
sources.origin: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs.
sources.guard: General BNG guidance is not a parcel survey, metric result, exemption decision, gain-plan approval or planning permission.

sources.title: Biodiversity net gain: what local planning authorities should do
sources.role: Defra operational guidance for local planning authorities.
sources.facts: Published 29 November 2023; updated 14 July 2026; describes application checks, gain-plan review, monitoring and local policies.
sources.origin: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs.
sources.guard: LPA process guidance does not prove that a specific application is valid, approved, compliant or monitored successfully.

sources.title: Biodiversity net gain: exempt developments
sources.role: Defra guidance describing categories of development that may be exempt from BNG.
sources.facts: Current guidance includes changes applying from 6 August 2026, including the 0.2 hectare threshold and temporary-development conditions.
sources.origin: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs.
sources.guard: An exemption description does not establish that a particular parcel or application satisfies every factual and legal condition.

sources.title: Calculate biodiversity value with the statutory biodiversity metric
sources.role: Defra guidance for using the statutory biodiversity metric.
sources.facts: Published 7 July 2021; updated 14 July 2026; explains metric use for habitats, developments, land managers and LPAs.
sources.origin: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs.
sources.guard: The metric guidance is not a completed site survey, validated calculation, accepted baseline or approved gain plan.

sources.title: Biodiversity net gain collection
sources.role: Official collection of BNG planning, delivery, register and NSIP guidance.
sources.facts: Updated 2 June 2026; links to current developer, land manager, LPA, register, credit and NSIP material.
sources.origin: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs.
sources.guard: A guidance collection is not complete evidence that any specific development has met BNG duties.

sources.title: Register a biodiversity gain site
sources.role: Defra and Natural England application guidance for gain-site registration.
sources.facts: Updated 2 June 2026; sets out applicant eligibility, evidence, legal agreement, metric, monitoring plan and application process.
sources.origin: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs and Natural England.
sources.guard: Application guidance or submission does not prove registration, ownership, allocation, habitat delivery or planning compliance.

sources.title: Search the biodiversity gain sites register
sources.role: Official access guidance for the biodiversity gain sites register.
sources.facts: Updated 2 June 2026; describes searchable registered-site, boundary, habitat and allocation information.
sources.origin: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs.
sources.guard: Register information reflects accepted applicant data and does not independently prove current habitat condition, title, performance or planning outcome.

sources.title: Local nature recovery strategies: areas and responsible authorities
sources.role: Defra map and list of LNRS areas and responsible authorities.
sources.facts: Published 30 June 2023; updated 26 June 2026; identifies strategy areas and authorities in England.
sources.origin: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs.
sources.guard: An LNRS area or strategy map does not prove parcel habitat value, deliverability, permission, funding or BNG allocation.
